layout.spacing: Generous outer padding, tightly coupled internal data groupings for a tactical command-center feel.

heroProgress.description: Massive typographic display of the current week's km. The progress bar is a thick, unrounded neon line (#CCFF00) over a dark zinc track. Text overlaps or sits flush with the bar.
heroProgress.classes: col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 bg-[#121214] border border-zinc-800 p-8 sm:p-12 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[400px]

allTimeTotal.description: Supporting widget for lifetime kms. Darker, quieter background with high contrast white numbers. Includes the dark minimal cyclist background image subtly.
allTimeTotal.classes: col-span-12 lg:col-span-4 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 p-8 flex flex-col justify-end relative overflow-hidden min-h-[400px]

rideList.description: Minimalist tabular layout for weekly rides. No bulky cards. Each ride is a row with a 1px border-bottom (border-zinc-800). Hover state lightens the row slightly. Data points: Title, Day, Distance, Action (Edit/Delete).

addRideForm.description: Tactical input fields. Square corners (rounded-none). Focus state triggers a vibrant primary accent border. Label text is tiny, uppercase, spaced out.
addRideForm.inputClasses: bg-transparent border border-zinc-800 rounded-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] text-white p-4 h-14 font-medium w-full
addRideForm.buttonClasses: bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-widest rounded-none h-14 hover:bg-[#A3CC00] transition-colors w-full px-8

weekNavigator.description: Massive chevrons (< >) flanking the 'WEEK X' text. Use ghost buttons for the chevrons with a hover state that turns the icon #CCFF00.
weekNavigator.classes: flex items-center gap-6 text-2xl font-black tracking-widest font-[Oswald] uppercase

motion.pageEntrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items.

background_image.description: Silhouette of cyclist at night. Use as a subtle, low-opacity (20%) background image inside the 'All Time Total' widget to give it cinematic depth, layered behind the text.

icons.usage: Minimal use of icons. Rely heavily on typography. Use sharp chevron icons for navigation, and minimalistic trash/edit icons for the list.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on zinc-900 passes APCA contrast. The primary accent (#CCFF00) should be used for thick UI elements or dark text on accent background. Do NOT use #CCFF00 for small thin text on dark background.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must use focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] focus:outline-none.

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind font family to map 'Oswald' to font-sans or a custom font utility like 'font-display', and 'Inter' to body.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk. Do NOT use purple/teal gradients. This is a brutalist, sporty aesthetic.
The progress bar must visually max out at 100km (100% width), but the numeric display should allow exceeding 100.
Ensure all components use 'rounded-none' for the tactical command-center feel.
Implement a SQLite database (FastAPI backend) to persist the rides and fetch stats efficiently.
Ensure the hero number uses 'tracking-tighter' and a massive font size (clamp or vw units) to pack the digits tightly and make it the focal point.
